description: User login request including name, observer mode, password or signature for authentication.
guidance: To test this API, provide a valid user name, an optional observer mode, and either a password or a signature. Ensure the name follows the specified character set and length restrictions, and the signature is correctly SHA-1 encrypted if used.

input.name: name
input.description: name of the user; length: 1-32; charset: _, 0-9, a-z, A-Z

input.name: observer
input.description: the default is empty, 1 is forced login, 2 is observer mode login

input.name: password
input.description: login password; choose one of signature and password. for the security of your account, it is recommended to log in with signature.

input.name: signature
input.description: login signature; rules:SHA-1 encryption of:name+timestamp(int)+SHA-1 encrypted password

description: UserLoginResponse definition which includes response code, message, and login result.
guidance: This step is used to test the response structure of a user login attempt. Verify that the response contains the expected fields: code, message, and result.

output.name: message
output.description: response message, description for the response code
